### Constraints

- Operating conventions for the insureveX stack: units are USDT 6 decimals, oracle prices 8 decimals per share (already divided by sharesMultiplier), barrier in bps (menu 100/200/300/500/700/1000), payout per $1 = min(max(-barrier - gap, 0), 20%), gap = Monday open / Friday close - 1. epochId = unix time of the Friday close (20:00 UTC in US daylight time, 21:00 UTC in winter; server knob EPOCH_CLOSE_HOUR_UTC), purchases revert after it, expectedOpen = epochId + 65.5h. Quotes: EIP-712 domain {name "insureveX CoverMarket", version "1"}, charged = max(fair x 1.5, 1bp), refuse above 2% of notional, TTL 15 min capped at the bell. Settlement print = first non-null official opening print at or after nextOpenTime, never the token print; corporate actions void the epoch and refund. Secrets live only in contracts/.env, server/.env, client/.env.local (gitignored); never copy them into docs or RecurOS.
